entries.speaker: First-Year Volleyball Player
entries.en: The other senpai said if we don't keep[n]our heads down, we'll end up getting[n]special coaching just like he did.

entries.speaker: First-Year Volleyball Player
entries.en: I-I mean, never mind. I[n]seriously don't know anything!
